about: Reference designed experiments from one published source, for testing that software reproduces them.
This source studies run orders: it prints designs (a 3^3 factorial, face-centred CCDs, a Box-Behnken design
and a 17-run design from a definitive screening design) in run orders found by integer programming, beside
orthogonal-polynomial time trends, and tabulates the average (Ave) and maximum (Max) absolute correlation
|cos| (equation [5]) between groups of model columns (ME main effects, IE two-factor interactions, QE
squares, uncentred) and each trend component (L linear, Q quadratic, C cubic). designs: each printed run order
(factors X1.. in coded units, runs with the time slot t and the trend columns Z1, Z2, Z3), with every number
printed for it, as printed text, where it is printed (journal page, PDF page and a quotation) and check: how
to recompute it, or manual, the reason it is not recomputed. The last entry holds run counts of designs the
paper names, from its Figures 3 and 4 and its text. Read with process_improve.experiments.reference.
